description_en: Retrieves the certificate information of a specified accelerated domain name
description_zh: 调用本接口获取指定加速域名的证书信息
name: DescribeVodDomainCertificateInfo

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name for ApsaraVideo VOD
parameters.name: domain_name

CertDomainName.description_en: The domain name matched by the certificate

CertExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the certificate. The time is displayed in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)

CertLife.description_en: The validity period of the certificate. Unit: months or years

CertRegion.description_en: The region where the certificate is used

CertStartTime.description_en: The start time of the certificate. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and is displayed in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
CertStartTime.description_zh: 证书开始时间。日期格式按照 ISO 8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

CertType.description_en:
The certificate type. Valid values:
free: Free certificate.
cas: SSL Certificates Service certificate.
upload: Custom upload
CertType.description_zh:
证书类型。取值：
free：免费证书
cas：云盾证书
upload：自定义上传

CertUpdateTime.description_en: The time when the certificate was updated. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and is displayed in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
CertUpdateTime.description_zh: 证书更新时间。日期格式按照 ISO 8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

DomainCnameStatus.description_en:
The CNAME status of the domain name. Valid values:
ok: The domain name is mapped to the CNAME allocated by Content Delivery Network (CDN).
cname_error: A fault occurred. The domain name cannot be mapped to the CNAME.
op_domain_cname_error: A fault occurred with the CNAME of the top-level domain. The domain name cannot be mapped to the CNAME.
unsupport_wildcard: Wildcard domain names are not supported
DomainCnameStatus.description_zh:
域名的CNAME状态：

ok:
域名指向了阿里云CDN分配的CNAME。
cname_error: 发生错误，域名无法指向CNAME。

op_domain_cname_error:
顶级域名的CNAME发生错误，域名无法指向CNAME。

unsupport_wildcard:
不支持通配符域名

ServerCertificateStatus.description_en:
The enabling status of the HTTPS certificate. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
ServerCertificateStatus.description_zh:
HTTPS证书开启状态。
on：已开启
off：未开启

Status.description_en:
The certificate status. Valid values:
success: The certificate has taken effect.
checking: Checking whether the domain name is added to ApsaraVideo VOD.
cname_error: The domain name is not mapped to the CNAME assigned by ApsaraVideo VOD.
domain_invalid: The domain name contains invalid characters.
unsupport_wildcard: Wildcard domain names are not supported.
applying: The certificate application is in progress.
failed: The certificate application failed.

This field returns a value only when CertType is set to free. For other certificate types, this field is empty
Status.description_zh:
证书状态。
success：已生效
checking：检测域名是否在阿里云点播
cname_error：域名没有切到阿里云点播
domain_invalid：域名包含非法字符
unsupport_wildcard：不支持泛域名
applying：证书申请中
failed：证书申请失败

仅当`CertType`为`free`时，该字段才会返回值，其他类型的证书该字段返回为空
